headline: Japan & US take joint steps to halt yen's fall
summary: Two Japanese officials told Reuters that Finance Minister Katayama will disclose that Tokyo and Washington engaged in a unified currency market operation to counter the yen's steep fall to its weakest against the dollar.
why: Coordinated intervention by Japan and the US signals official resistance to yen weakness, which directly affects USD/JPY trading and Japanese asset returns for foreign investors.
